Submitted (final).

**Proposal — fallback level, § 3.2 (p0040), one operation:**
- Replace "at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term" with "at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term".

Per the verifier's minimality point, I struck the appended declaratory sentence: it duplicated the effect of the numeral substitution and needlessly recast a mutual notice window as one-sided. The cure now rests solely on the sixty (60) day substitution, in the document's house numbering style.

**Element coverage:** ≤60-day non-renewal window — addressed by operation 1; 5% renewal price cap — not engaged, as renewal carries the prior term forward with no uplift mechanic (already_met, quoted from p0040).

**Noted, not redlined:** preferred wording (30-day opt-out, 60-day vendor reminder, 12-month renewal terms) is not reached; and because renewal duration mirrors the previous term, any Service Option Attachment longer than 12 months would produce automatic multi-year renewals — confirm attachment durations and escalate to a 12-month renewal-term cap if so.
